Text: A royal letter arrives: "The old town lies in ruins, and you're the one to bring it back. Start with a Guild Hall: it will be your home base, and its Bank keeps everything you bring home safe. Here's some stone and the plans." Buildings need their blueprint, plus materials (and sometimes gold). Click Build on the Guild Hall.

"Well done! Next, an Inn, so adventurers have somewhere to stay. That takes more stone, and the Plains are full of it." Press Start Next Run and head to the Plains. No monsters this time, just rocks: the trip shows you how to explore. Bring home 5 Stone and build the Inn.

"Welcome! An Adventurer just checked in, and you've got a town to run, so leave the fighting to them. First job: Green Slimes are oozing all over the Plains road. Bring me back 5 Green Ooze." Pick the Adventurer on Character Select. Green Slimes drop Green Ooze. Like gold, it's only yours once you get home.
Rewards: Blueprint Alchemist; Room Plains: Blue Slime Patch; Room Plains: Blue Slime Ambush

Text: "An old alchemist wants to set up shop. Build a workshop and the Alchemist will brew you a Health Flask from that Ooze." Flasks refill at the start of every run. Blue Slimes now live in the Plains too.
"Something BIG is growing in the Plains. I've marked its nest on your map." The Big Slime Nest is now in the Plains room deck for good. Beat it, then Go Deeper at its campfire to reach Tier 2.
"I like to carry a bit of everything. Well, a LOT of everything. Open some Plains Booster Packs and I'll show you a new way to fight." Packs come from quests, chests and the Shop.
"The roads won't be safe until the monsters are thinned out. Defeat 10 of them, any kind, and I'll make it worth your while."
"Good work! There are plenty more out there. Defeat 20 more."
"The travellers are talking about you! One last push: defeat 30 more."
